#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text: Sub: Filling up the post of Joint Director earmarked for Indian Police Service (IPS) officers under Non-Central Staffing Scheme of the MoEF&CC in Wildlife Crime Control Bureau HQ, New Delhi in WCCB-reg.

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: I am directed to refer to the subject cited above and to say that Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change intends to fill up the below mentioned one post, on deputation basis:-

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text: 2. It is, therefore, requested that aforesaid post may be given wider publicity and names of willing IPS officers of the rank of DIG may be forwarded to this Ministry at the earliest. While sending the nominations, it may please be ensured that the officers are clear from vigilance angle. The names should be reached this Ministry within a period of one month after issuance of this letter.
